theorem lg_target (x : ENNReal) (y : ℝ) : x ^ y = (↑y * x.log).exp := by
  cases x
  case some x' =>
    rw [ENNReal.pow_def]
    rw [ENNReal.exp_def]
    erw [mul_comm]
    erw [exp_exp]
    erw [log_def]
    erw [mul_assoc]
    erw [mul_left_comm]
    erw [mul_eq_mul]
  case none =>
    have h : ENNReal.ofReal 0 ^ y = 0 := by rw [pow_zero]
    have k : (↑y * ENNReal.ofReal 0).exp = 0 := by rw [mul_zero, exp_zero]
    rw [h]
    rw [k]
